description: This file defines the PendingAction class within the OrangeHRM Dashboard module. It encapsulates a summary of pending actions, utilizing an ActionSummary object to generate a structured array if there are pending actions.

classes.name: PendingAction
classes.description: A class representing pending action summaries in the dashboard, utilizing localization traits and aggregating data from an ActionSummary instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PendingAction with an ActionSummary instance.

methods.name: generateActionSummary
methods.description: Generates an array with details about pending actions if any are present; returns null otherwise.
